SELECT 
    distregistry,
    (impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'casualties')::int AS casualties,
    (impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'injured')::int AS injured,
    (impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'missing')::int AS missing,
    (impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'displaced')::int AS displaced,
    (impact_summary->'infrastructure_damage'->>'infra_damage_pct')::real AS infra_damage_pct,
    (impact_summary->'infrastructure_damage'->>'power_outage_pct')::real AS power_outage_pct,
    (impact_summary->'infrastructure_damage'->>'water_damage_pct')::real AS water_damage_pct
FROM disasterevents LIMIT 3;

WITH disaster_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        d.distregistry,
        (10 * COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'casualties')::int, 0)) +
        (3 * COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'injured')::int, 0)) +
        (2 * COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'missing')::int, 0)) +
        (1 * COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'displaced')::int, 0)) AS pis,
        (COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'infrastructure_damage'->>'infra_damage_pct')::real, 0) +
         COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'infrastructure_damage'->>'power_outage_pct')::real, 0) +
         COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'infrastructure_damage'->>'water_damage_pct')::real, 0)) / 3.0 AS idi,
        (0.6 * ((10 * COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'casualties')::int, 0)) +
                (3 * COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'injured')::int, 0)) +
                (2 * COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'missing')::int, 0)) +
                (1 * COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'displaced')::int, 0))) +
         0.4 * ((COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'infrastructure_damage'->>'infra_damage_pct')::real, 0) +
                 COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'infrastructure_damage'->>'power_outage_pct')::real, 0) +
                 COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'infrastructure_damage'->>'water_damage_pct')::real, 0)) / 3.0) AS dsi
    FROM disasterevents d
),
hub_dsi_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        s.supplyhubref AS hubregistry,
        AVG(dm.dsi) AS avg_dsi_served
    FROM supplies s
    JOIN disaster_metrics dm ON s.supply_dist_ref = dm.distregistry
    GROUP BY s.supplyhubref
)
SELECT 
    dh.hubregistry,
    ROUND(CAST(
        (0.5 * ((dh.hubutilpct / 100.0) + (dh.stockturnrate / 10.0))) + 
        (0.5 * COALESCE(hda.avg_dsi_served, 0))
    AS numeric), 2) AS hub_strain_index,
    CASE 
        WHEN (0.5 * ((dh.hubutilpct / 100.0) + (dh.stockturnrate / 10.0))) + 
             (0.5 * COALESCE(hda.avg_dsi_served, 0)) > 1000000 THEN 'Overwhelmed'
        ELSE 'Normal'
    END AS status
FROM distributionhubs dh
LEFT JOIN hub_dsi_avg hda ON dh.hubregistry = hda.hubregistry
ORDER BY hub_strain_index DESC;
